title.zh-TW: 主計總處上修今年經濟成長預估至13.28%，明年估6.51%
title.en: DGBAS raises Taiwan's 2026 GDP growth forecast to 13.28%, sees 6.51% in 2027

summary.zh-TW: 主計總處11月27日公布最新預測，將今年經濟成長率上修2.23個百分點至13.28%，為近半世紀新高；明年預估6.51%。同時預估今年商品出口約9,386億美元、年增46.67%，明年約1.11兆美元，有望首度突破1兆美元。以上數字均為官方預估，尚非實績。
summary.en: Taiwan's statistics agency on Nov 27 lifted its 2026 growth forecast by 2.23 points to 13.28%, the highest in nearly half a century, and projected 6.51% for 2027. It also forecast 2026 goods exports of about US$938.6bn (+46.67%) and roughly US$1.11tn in 2027, which would be a first above US$1tn. These figures are official forecasts, not final results.

impact.zh-TW: 官方數據反映AI伺服器與零組件出口仍是台灣成長主軸；主計總處也列出美國出口管制、融資成本、AI應用進度及關稅為變數，高基期下明年預估能否實現仍待觀察。
impact.en: The forecast shows AI server and component exports remain Taiwan's main growth engine. DGBAS itself flags US export controls, financing costs, AI adoption pace and tariffs as risks, so next year's projection against a high base is not assured.

title.zh-TW: 美國新規限制遠端存取先進晶片，傳Nvidia買家須排除中企租用
title.en: US rule curbs remote access to advanced chips; Nvidia buyers reportedly must exclude Chinese renters

summary.zh-TW: 中央社綜合CNBC報導，美國商務部產業安全局發布暫行最終規則限制遠端存取先進AI晶片。據匿名消息來源，新雲端業者若出租算力給中國企業，將無法購買Nvidia晶片，部分賣家正為原租給中企的GPU另尋買家。Nvidia與BIS未即時回應。
summary.en: Citing CNBC, CNA reported that the US Commerce Department's BIS issued an interim final rule restricting remote access to advanced AI chips. Anonymous sources said neoclouds renting compute to Chinese firms cannot buy Nvidia chips, and some sellers are seeking new buyers for affected GPUs. Nvidia and BIS did not immediately comment.

impact.zh-TW: 規範若嚴格執行，海外資料中心的客戶組成審查將更嚴，可能影響部分AI伺服器出貨節奏與去化；買家排除條件來自匿名消息，實際執行範圍仍待官方確認。
impact.en: If enforced strictly, customer vetting at overseas data centers tightens, which could affect some AI server shipment timing. The buyer conditions come from anonymous sources, so the actual enforcement scope awaits official confirmation.

title.zh-TW: 中國10月工業利潤年增20.1%，電子業受AI算力需求帶動
title.en: China's October industrial profits rise 20.1% as AI demand lifts electronics

summary.zh-TW: 中國國家統計局公布，1至10月規模以上工業企業利潤年增16.0%，10月單月年增20.1%。電腦、通信及電子設備製造業利潤年增100%，拉動整體9.7個百分點；汽車製造業則年減26.0%。統計局將電子業成長歸因於AI算力需求。
summary.en: China's statistics bureau said above-scale industrial profits rose 16.0% y/y in January–October and 20.1% in October alone. Computer, communications and electronics manufacturing profits doubled, adding 9.7 points, while auto manufacturing fell 26.0%. The bureau attributed electronics gains to AI computing demand.

impact.zh-TW: 數據顯示AI相關電子製造的獲利動能跨區擴散，但成長集中於少數產業，汽車等傳統產業仍疲弱；外資、港澳台投資企業利潤僅增0.2%，對台廠的直接意涵有限。
impact.en: The data show AI-linked electronics profits spreading across regions, but gains are concentrated while autos and other traditional sectors stay weak. Profits at foreign and HK/Macau/Taiwan-invested firms rose only 0.2%, limiting direct read-through for Taiwanese firms.

title.zh-TW: AI股領漲科技股反彈，美股四大指數收紅、費半漲4.69%
title.en: AI stocks lead tech rebound; US indexes close higher, SOX up 4.69%

summary.zh-TW: 美股27日在動盪一週後收高，Micron、AMD與SanDisk等AI相關股大漲。道瓊上漲1.18%至50,774.94點，標普500漲1.60%至7,297.49點，那斯達克漲2.31%至24,129.50點，費城半導體指數漲4.69%至9,186.707點。
summary.en: After a volatile week, US stocks closed higher on Nov 27, led by AI-related names such as Micron, AMD and SanDisk. The Dow rose 1.18% to 50,774.94, the S&P 500 1.60% to 7,297.49, the Nasdaq 2.31% to 24,129.50, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index 4.69% to 9,186.707.

impact.zh-TW: 費半大漲可能改善下週一台股半導體與記憶體族群的開盤氣氛，但這是單日跌深反彈；本週AI投資報酬疑慮與外資連續賣超台股的情況尚未改變。
impact.en: The SOX jump may improve sentiment for Taiwan's semiconductor and memory names at Monday's open, but it is a one-day rebound after steep losses; AI return worries and persistent foreign selling of Taiwan stocks have not changed.

title.zh-TW: Counterpoint：記憶體漲價衝擊Android，iPhone美國市占升至57%
title.en: Counterpoint: memory price rises hit Android; iPhone's US share climbs to 57%

summary.zh-TW: 科技新報引述Counterpoint Research，美國第三季智慧型手機出貨年減9%，記憶體與零組件成本上升對利潤較薄的低階Android機種衝擊最大。Apple是唯一出貨未衰退的主要品牌，市占由50%升至57%；Motorola由12%降至8%。分析師預期記憶體成本將持續偏高。
summary.en: TechNews, citing Counterpoint Research, said US smartphone shipments fell 9% y/y in Q3 as higher memory and component costs hit thin-margin low-end Android models hardest. Apple was the only major brand without a decline, lifting share from 50% to 57%, while Motorola slipped from 12% to 8%. Analysts expect memory costs to stay elevated.

impact.zh-TW: 記憶體報價上漲有利供應端，但也壓抑終端需求與低階機種出貨；分析師對第四季銷售偏弱與成本續高的看法屬預估，需留意漲價對消費性電子需求的反噬。
impact.en: Higher memory prices favor suppliers but weigh on end demand and low-end device shipments. Analysts' views of weak Q4 sales and persistently high costs are forecasts; watch for demand destruction in consumer electronics.

reason.zh-TW: 主計總處上修成長主要依賴AI相關出口，費半單日大漲也牽動晶圓代工族群；台積電為台灣AI晶片製造核心，屬產業推論，報導未直接提及。
reason.en: DGBAS's upgrade rests on AI-related exports and the SOX surge affects foundry sentiment; TSMC is the core of Taiwan's AI chip manufacturing. Industry inference — not named in the reports.

risk.zh-TW: 美國出口管制擴大、AI投資報酬疑慮與外資持續賣超，可能壓抑評價。
risk.en: Wider US export controls, doubts over AI returns and persistent foreign selling could weigh on valuation.

reason.zh-TW: AI伺服器出口是官方預估出口創高的主要動能，而美國遠端存取新規可能改變海外資料中心客戶結構；鴻海為主要AI伺服器組裝廠，屬產業推論。
reason.en: AI server exports drive the record export forecast, while the US remote-access rule may reshape overseas data-center customers; Hon Hai is a major AI server assembler. Industry inference only.

risk.zh-TW: 出口管制執行細節不明、客戶審查趨嚴可能延後出貨，毛利率亦受組裝業競爭影響。
risk.en: Unclear enforcement details and stricter customer vetting may delay shipments; assembly competition pressures margins.

reason.zh-TW: Counterpoint指出記憶體成本上升，美股Micron與SanDisk領漲，反映記憶體報價題材受關注；南亞科為台灣DRAM廠，屬產業推論。
reason.en: Counterpoint cites rising memory costs, and Micron and SanDisk led the US rally, keeping memory pricing in focus; Nanya is a Taiwanese DRAM maker. Industry inference only.

risk.zh-TW: 記憶體價格循環波動大，漲價抑制手機等終端需求可能反過來影響後續報價。
risk.en: Memory prices are highly cyclical, and price rises that dampen phone demand could later pressure pricing.

reason.zh-TW: AI晶片需求帶動台灣出口及中國電子業獲利，先進封裝與測試為AI晶片供應鏈關鍵環節；日月光投控為全球封測大廠，屬產業推論。
reason.en: AI chip demand lifts Taiwan's exports and China's electronics profits, and advanced packaging and testing are key AI supply-chain steps; ASE is a global leader. Industry inference only.

risk.zh-TW: 成熟製程與消費性電子需求偏弱，加上產能擴充的折舊壓力，可能抵銷AI相關成長。
risk.en: Weak mature-node and consumer demand plus depreciation from capacity expansion could offset AI-related growth.

sector.zh-TW: 電源／資料中心基礎設施

reason.zh-TW: 主計總處指AI基礎設施與設備仍供不應求，資料中心電源與散熱屬相關設備；台達電為電源管理大廠，屬產業推論，報導未直接提及。
reason.en: DGBAS says AI infrastructure and equipment remain in short supply, which includes data-center power and cooling; Delta is a leading power-management firm. Industry inference — not named in the reports.

risk.zh-TW: AI資本支出若因融資成本或監管趨嚴而放緩，資料中心相關訂單可能遞延；評價對AI題材敏感。
risk.en: If AI capex slows on financing costs or tighter regulation, data-center orders could be deferred; valuation is sensitive to AI sentiment.
